clinicalPearls: Le Fort III floats entire face off skull
White eyed blowout in child is surgical urgency
CSF test is beta 2 transferrin, not glucose
Retrobulbar haemorrhage: canthotomy before CT when vision dying
reference.pathophysiology: Hydraulic globe pressure fractures thin orbital walls sparing rim, while midface buttress failure at Le Fort levels dissociates occlusion bearing skeleton; dural tears at cribriform leak CSF along olfactory fila pathways.
additionalDifferentials: Orbital blowout versus globe rupture examination separation
CSF rhinorrhoea versus allergic clear discharge (beta 2 transferrin)
Zygomatic versus maxillary fracture by arch and buttress signs
additionalInvestigations: CT face with fine cuts and 3D, CT head and c spine by trauma protocol
Ophthalmology assessment, ocular motility and vision charting
